content.name: Callum Hargreaves
content.title: Software Engineer (C# / .NET)
content.summary: Software engineer with nine years in C# and .NET, most recently on patient-record systems used by GP surgeries across Yorkshire. Led the move of a monolithic referrals module to Azure-hosted services, halving release lead time. Mentors two junior developers and cares about readable code and boring, predictable deployments.

experience.title: Graduate Software Developer
bullets: Maintained the quote engine for a motor insurance product handling roughly 18,000 quotes a day, fixing 120+ defects from the support queue.
Introduced xUnit tests around the premium calculation rules, which caught three pricing regressions before they reached brokers.
Automated the monthly broker commission export with a scheduled .NET console job, saving the finance team two days of spreadsheet work each month.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built Direct Debit mandate APIs in ASP.NET Core for 300+ small-business merchants, meeting Bacs submission windows with zero missed files over two years.
Reduced failed payment retries by 22% by redesigning the retry scheduler around Bacs return codes instead of fixed intervals.
Moved the team from manual releases to Azure DevOps pipelines, taking deployment from a half-day ritual to a 15-minute job.
Ran fortnightly lunch-and-learn sessions on domain-driven design for a team of nine.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Led the split of the referrals module out of a 400,000-line monolith into four Azure-hosted services, cutting release lead time from ten days to five.
Implemented FHIR-based endpoints so 210 GP surgeries could exchange referral letters electronically, removing around 6,000 posted letters a month.
Tuned slow Entity Framework queries on the appointments screen, bringing p95 response time down from 2.4 s to 600 ms.
Mentor two junior developers through code review and pairing; both now own features end to end.

education.details: Dissertation: static analysis of null-reference bugs in C# codebases.

achievements.title: Internal engineering award, Wharfedale Health Records
achievements.detail: Recognised for the referrals migration, delivered without a single unplanned outage for surgeries.

achievements.title: Speaker, Leeds .NET user group
achievements.detail: Gave a talk on strangler-fig migrations to an audience of about 70 developers.
